slides.heading: Function Reuse
slides.body: Function Reuse is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Function Reuse
slides.body: Reusable functions prevent repeated code. Instead of rewriting the same lines, define the task once and call it when needed.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A reusable function is like a stamp. You design it once and can use it many times.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Define a separator function and call it three times.
slides.hint: Call separator() three times after the function.

coding_challenge.hint_text: Use the idea from the lesson. Keep the code short, readable, and correctly indented.
